propertySets.name: Pset_HumidifierPHistory
propertySets.definition:
Humidifier performance history attributes.
Sound attribute deleted in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum: Use IfcSoundProperties instead.

properties.name: SaturationEfficiency
properties.definition: Saturation efficiency: Ratio of leaving air absolute humidity to the maximum absolute humidity.

propertySets.name: Pset_HumidifierTypeCommon
propertySets.definition:
Humidifier type common attributes.
WaterProperties attribute renamed to WaterRequirement and unit type modified in IFC2x2 Pset Addendum.

properties.name: Reference
properties.definition: Reference ID for this specified type in this project (e.g. type 'A-1'), Also referred to as "construction type". It should be provided as an alternative to the name of the "object type", if the software does not support object types and no classification reference to a recognized classification system used.IFC4.3.0.0 DEPRECATION  The Reference property is deprecated and shall no longer be used, use attribute Name on the relating type instead.

properties.name: Status
properties.definition: Status of the element, predominately used in renovation or retrofitting projects. The status can be assigned to as "New" - element designed as new addition, "Existing" - element exists and remains, "Demolish" - element existed but is to be demolished,  "Temporary" - element will exists only temporary (like a temporary support structure).

properties.name: HumidifierApplication
properties.definition:
Humidifier application.Fixed: Humidifier installed in a ducted flow distribution system.
Portable: Humidifier is not installed in a ducted flow distribution system.

properties.name: NominalMoistureGain
properties.definition: Nominal rate of water vapor added into the airstream.

properties.name: NominalAirFlowRate
properties.definition:
Nominal air flow rate.

Nominal rate of air flow into which water vapor is added.

properties.name: SaturationEfficiencyCurve
properties.definition: Saturation efficiency as a function of the air flow rate.

properties.name: AirPressureDropCurve
properties.definition:
Air pressure drop as a function of air flow rate.

Air pressure drop versus air-flow rate.

propertySets.name: Qto_HumidifierBaseQuantities
propertySets.definition: Base quantities that are common to the definition of all types of humidifiers.
